import { Vendor } from '../types';
import {
  Tabs,
  TabsList,
  TabsTrigger,
  TabsContent,
} from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

import ContactDialog from './contact-dialog';
import VendorCalendar from './vendor-calender';
import VendorCard from './vendor-card';
import VendorPackages from './vendor-packages';
import VendorReviews from './vendor-reviews';

export default function VendorDetailsPage({
  params: { id },
}: {
  params: { id: string };
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('overview');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>();
  const [vendor, setVendor] = useState<Vendor>();

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchVendor = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        // Fetch vendor data
        const response = await fetch(`/api/vendors/${id}`);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch vendor');
        const data = await response.json();
        setVendor(data);
      } catch (err) {
        setError(
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong'
        );
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchVendor();
  }, [id]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="animate-pulse">Loading...</div>;
  }

  if (error || !vendor) {
    return (
      <div className="text-red-500">
        {error || 'Vendor not found'}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <VendorCard
        vendor={vendor}
        onContactClick={setSelectedVendor}
        onPackageClick={handlePackageSelect}
      />

      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
        <TabsList>
          <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="packages">Packages</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="availability">Availability</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="reviews">Reviews</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="overview">
          {/* Vendor details */}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="packages">
          <VendorPackages
            packages={vendor.packages}
            onSelect={handlePackageSelect}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="availability">
          <VendorCalendar
            availability={vendor.availability || []}
            onDateSelect={handleDateSelect}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="reviews">
          <VendorReviews reviews={vendor.reviews} />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      {selectedVendor && (
        <ContactDialog
          isOpen={!!selectedVendor}
          onClose={() => setSelectedVendor(null)}
          vendor={selectedVendor}
          onSubmit={handleContact}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
